scope: Experimental forearm/root and counter-wrist transform. No teaching/anatomical approval.
limitations: Finite genuine forearm remains visibly cropped from some freely rotated views.
Counter-wrist rotation is an authored +25 degree feasibility adjustment; it has not received anatomical lesson approval.
Every hand vertex without forearm skin influence is preserved within 0.0000072 mm; vertices in the real wrist/forearm transition deform.

forearmFeasibility.method: Rotate forearm/root world-X by +25 degrees; counter-rotate wrist local quaternion; preserve wrist anchor and every descendant joint world transform. Source arm mesh/weights unchanged.
forearmFeasibility.comparisonScope: all wrist/metacarpal/finger bones; skin vertices weighted partly to forearm may move at wrist transition
